about: Claude Code 2.1.317: its UserPromptSubmit hook for a prompt the user sent, then for the turn it started by itself when that prompt's background Bash command ended (HI-2410). Recorded with claude -p in a new CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (a made-up API key), --settings hooks saving their input, against a local stand-in model API that ran one background Bash (sleep 3 && echo done) and then replied; no sign-in, nothing sent to a real model. The two carry the same fields: only the prompt text tells the task's wake apart. Paths and the session id replaced.
